defs: def tool($id): .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $id); def plugin: .manifest.plugins[0]; def targets: [.config.agent_targets[].target_id] | sort;

jq.name: the manifest is a 2.0.0 documents pack with no graph or schema and exactly one plugin
jq.expr: .manifest | .version == "2.0.0" and .kind == "documents" and (has("schemas") | not) and (has("compiler_version") | not) and (.plugins | length == 1) and (.tags | type == "array" and index("graph") == null) and .dependencies == []

jq.name: no graph, datastore, stage task, schema, .rhai or workflows asset remains
jq.expr: (.config | keys) as $k | (["graph_capabilities", "graph_intents", "graphs", "datastore_tool_surfaces", "tasks"] | all(. as $x | $k | index($x) == null)) and ([.config.tools[] | has("datastore")] | any | not) and ([.assets | keys[] | select(startswith("graphs/") or startswith("schemas/") or endswith(".rhai") or startswith("workflows/") or startswith("tasks/"))] | length == 0)

jq.name: review_changes is a Rust job plugin with no asset mount, with TOOL.md and bounded limits
jq.expr: plugin | .name == "review_changes" and .language == "rust" and .job == true and (has("asset_mounts") | not) and .artifact == "plugins/review_changes.afb" and .instructions == "plugins/review_changes/TOOL.md" and .input_schema.properties.agent_budget.maximum == 1024 and (.input_schema.properties.args.properties | keys) == ["base", "focus", "head", "repository"] and .limits.wall_clock_secs <= 900 and (has("data") | not) and (has("catalog") | not) and (has("bind_dir") | not)

jq.name: the artifact, TOOL.md and every fixture are declared assets
jq.expr: .manifest.assets as $a | (["plugins/review_changes.afb", "plugins/review_changes/TOOL.md"] | all(. as $x | $a | index($x) != null)) and ([$a[] | select(startswith("plugins/review_changes/tests/"))] | length >= 13)

jq.name: the caller Tools template wires the plugin as a job over exactly the four review targets
jq.expr: . as $d | tool("review-changes-caller") | .integrations.plugins | length == 1 and (.[0] | .plugin == "gents/review_changes" and (.job.agent_targets | sort) == ($d | targets) and .job.max_live >= 4 and .job.max_spawns >= 22 and .job.max_messages_per_slot >= 2)

jq.name: the caller Tools template grants the caller nothing else
jq.expr: tool("review-changes-caller") | (.host == null) and (.built_ins == null) and (.integrations | keys) == ["plugins"]

jq.name: verify Tools exact
jq.expr: tool("review-verify-tools") | (.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and .host.bash.mode == "ReadOnly" and .host.bash.execution_mode == null and .host.bash.network_mode == "disabled" and .host.bash.background_enabled == null and ((.host.cli // []) | length == 0) and .integrations.lsp == null and .built_ins.enable_context_budget == true and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null

jq.name: recon and scan have no file tools
jq.expr: . as $d | ["review-recon", "review-scan"] | all(. as $id | [$d | tool($id)] | length == 1 and (.[0] | (.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and .host.bash.mode == "ReadOnly" and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null))

jq.name: triage has no tools and keeps the context budget
jq.expr: tool("review-triage") | (.host == null) and (.integrations == null) and .built_ins.enable_context_budget == true and .built_ins.enable_goal_tools == null

jq.name: every agent_targets row has target_id == name and names an existing agent
jq.expr: . as $d | $d.config.agent_targets | length == 4 and all(.target_id == .name and .name == "code-review-" + (.agent_id | ltrimstr("review-")) and (.agent_id as $a | any($d.config.agents[]; .agent_id == $a)))

jq.name: recon max_output_chars >= 1000000 so a large diff listing is not cut
Use from a Task treats unverified candidates and blocked lenses as not clean
jq.expr: (.assets["README.md"] // "" | split("## Use from a Task") | .[1] // "" | split("\n## ") | .[0]) as $s | ($s | contains("counts.unverified")) and (["correctness:", "architecture-reuse:", "security-concurrency:", "workflow-invariants:"] | all(. as $id | $s | contains("`" + $id + "`")))

jq.name: no review persona has the sessions history tool (a child must answer from its own work, never by reading transcripts)
